page.title: Card step for Linen tea towel

product.name: Linen tea towel
product.description: The towel is linen, hemmed, for drying cups.

blocks.text: No sleeve is ticked. No repeat parcel is marked.
The shelf card lists eleven on hand in the stockroom.
You are paying Fieldbasket at www.fieldbasket.example.
The form wants the digits on the plastic, the month and year, and the short code on the back.
It does not ask for the sign-in secret of your bank site.
The host in the header is the shop you opened. The tag on Linen tea towel matches the amount due.
